verdict.rationale: treg is a catalog of agent tools and provider endpoints, so registry discovery applies. Its docs say every catalogued endpoint can be inspected for price, parameters and an example response, and platform pages compare providers on success rate, speed and price. That covers tools and their inputs before calling them. Nothing shows per-server transport or hosting attributes, or formal input schemas. missing for 10: transport details per listing, hosting attributes (self-hosted vs. remote, location), formal JSON input schemas per tool, independent or hands-on corroboration of the inspection workflow

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect a listed server's tools, input schemas, transport, and hosting attributes before connecting to it

citations.quote: Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
`/catalog/platforms/{slug}` lists them side by side with measured success rate, speed and price.
